title.en: les puces, the sunday flea market.
title.tr: les puces, pazar günü pire pazarı.

line.en: the big flea market in la madrague-ville, open sunday morning. go early; the stalls close around 14:00.
line.de: der große flohmarkt in la madrague-ville, sonntagvormittags geöffnet. früh kommen; die stände schließen gegen 14:00.
line.tr: la madrague-ville'de büyük pire pazarı, pazar sabahları açık. erken gidin; tezgâhlar 14:00 civarı kapanır.

sparks.why: Les Puces, 130 chemin de la Madrague-Ville, Sunday 8:30-14:00 per the centre's own site; other listings say 6:00 or 7:30, so check on the day, as 1 nov is a Toussaint Sunday.
